files.title: Indicative Real-Time Reserve ORDC Price Adder

comparison.scope: Every original timestamp, repeat-hour flag, numeric field and member identity independently compared in tests/test_indicative_ordc.py; manual clock conversion for expected dates does not use SDK parsing helpers.

fixture.selection: Entire original ZIP, byte-for-byte, including all 34 CSVs.

limitations: Interim indicative results before June 1, 2014; not realized settlement prices.
The page description ends November 20 but actual files end November 19, 2013.
Original 00:xx AM timestamp text and repeat-hour flags retained; no inferred timezone or resampling.
